name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and operates Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including site configuration, certificates, security hardening, firewall rules, SSH restrictions, fail2ban, sysctl settings, and static content.

name: cache
description: Provisions Memcached and Redis, including Redis configuration, password protection, Fedora-compatible PID and log paths, and service enablement.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Installs PostgreSQL and Python tooling, deploys the FastAPI tutorial application in a virtual environment, configures its database and environment, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
